//: SysPerf configuration. Copy to your data directory as sysperf.config.json.
//_note: Every key is optional; anything omitted keeps its default. Environment variables (PERFDASH_*, SYSPERF_*) beat this file. Restart SysPerf after editing. Every key below is read by the code (tests/test_config_example.py checks this).
//_server: Loopback only. There is no authentication, so a non-loopback host is not supported. allowed_hosts lists extra Host names the dashboard answers to (e.g. one a local reverse proxy forwards); every other Host is refused.
//_sampling: sample_seconds is the fast tier, clamped to 30-600; slow metrics refresh every 5th sample. collector.persistent_shell reuses one PowerShell process. history.raw_days keeps raw samples 1-90 days; hourly summaries are kept for 400 days.
//_fixes: fixes.enabled=false is the kill switch: nothing that changes the PC runs (fixes, Explorer watchdog, tray auto-quit, OneDrive control); everything is still detected and previewed.
//_autoimprove: The scan -> RCA -> fix -> verify loop. mode (off | observe | auto) is the initial mode; the dashboard's choice is persisted. threshold (50-100): score below which RCA runs. allow_caution also lets 'caution' fixes such as restarting Explorer run unattended. max_actions per cycle (0-10); cooldown_seconds before an action repeats; settle_seconds before a fix's effect is measured.
//_version_check: Once a day, read public release feeds for the Components view. Nothing about this PC is sent.
//_wifi: Put your SSID in plan_mbps with the speed you pay for (e.g. {"MyHome": 100}); the Wi-Fi link then scores against that instead of an absolute ladder.
//_targets: Fractions of THIS machine's capacity, applied when the baseline is captured. Raising a fraction makes the target easier; lowering it makes it stricter. To capture a new baseline, delete baseline.json from the data directory and restart.
//_browser_hosts: Which apps' embedded-browser (WebView2) processes you cannot close (mandatory) and which are merely in use. Anything unlisted counts as discretionary.
//_drivers: Drivers whose old INF date you have checked is still the newest available (name -> date checked). Listed as verified, never hidden.
